reviews.comment: Brought an intricate Pinterest reference and Sirii recreated every detail effortlessly. Zero lifting after 4 weeks! The cleanliness and hospitality made it such a relaxing afternoon.
Stunning architecture and retention! Lasted 4 weeks without any lifting.

The studio is super clean, the vibe is very friendly. Simran mam is amazing at understanding what you want. She gives such great ideas and helps you find the perfect design and colour! Definitely coming back again. Highly recommend!

Absolutely loved my nails! They turned out so pretty, and I'm genuinely happy with how they look. The owners were super sweet, friendly, and helpful with their suggestions, which made the whole experience even better. They really understand what suits you and help you choose the best design.

Got my nails done by siri and I'm in love! I chose almond shape with nude base and golden chrome French tips. Finishing is super neat and classy, exactly like the reference picture. The couple was very polite and hygienic. Totally worth it, highly recommend!

Recently visited Nails by Siri with my sister, and this review isn't just about the amazing nail services, it's also about the incredible hospitality we experienced there. The couple running the studio was genuinely warm, sweet, and extremely welcoming. The services were absolutely top-notch!

It was my first time getting my nails done at Nails by Sirii and I can't get over how gorgeous these nails turned out! I showed them the inspiration pictures and they executed it perfectly The artistry and precision in the hand painted flowers are truly impressive. Thank you so much, I love them!

I had a wonderful experience! The nail extensions turned out so beautiful and exactly how I wanted. The work was neat, the finishing was perfect, and the staff was very polite and friendly. They paid attention to every little detail. Highly recommended!

Simran ma'am is so good in teaching Nail Course. I was a beginner to understand the whole things about Nails, but Ma'am and Sir both made me super Pro and trust me everyone now I am doing so good. If you are planning to get your nails done or take a Nail Tech Course, I'll genuinely suggest Nails by Sirii, super reasonable!

I had a great experience with both of them. They are not just great at what they do but very humble and calm human beings. I just showed them a picture of what I wanted and I got the exact same. Definitely going to revisit. Much love
I have done the nails exactly as told and they look very nice to me and the owner, both are very sweet, thank you so much, nails by Siri
